policy: Only the verified not_evaluated metrics_full.profit_factor +Infinity ratio may map to JSON null; all other nonfinite or unsupported values block acceptance.

fields.reason: strategy_core.metrics.calculate_metrics defines profit_factor as +Infinity when completed round trips exist and total loss is zero; the captured round trips have positive realized profit and no nonpositive P&L. The prototype gate status is not_evaluated, so this descriptive ratio did not control the frozen Gate001 verdict.
